<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard binary package build script for the `watchit-rs-bin` AUR package, which distributes a pre-built Rust binary of a terminal IMDb browser. The analysis reveals no security concerns.

**Source verification:** All three sources (README, x86_64 binary, aarch64 binary) are fetched from the package's own upstream GitHub repository (`github.com/isene/watchit` and `raw.githubusercontent.com/isene/watchit`). All three have valid SHA-256 checksums provided (none are set to 'SKIP'). The version tag `v0.8.1` is used consistently across source URLs and checksum entries.

**Package function:** The `package()` function uses only standard `install` commands to place the binary at `/usr/bin/watchit` (mode 755) and the README at `/usr/share/doc/watchit-rs-bin/README.md` (mode 644). No post-install hooks, no system modifications, no configuration file changes.

**No suspicious patterns:** There is no obfuscation, no `eval`/`base64`/`curl`/`wget`/`git pull` commands. The dependencies (`glibc`, `libgcc`) are standard for a Rust binary. The `!strip` option is normal for `-bin` packages. The architecture list (`x86_64`, `aarch64`) matches the `source_x86_64` and `source_aarch64` arrays.

No evidence of malicious or dangerous behavior was found.</details>
